titre_page: How to make a character jump in Yop2D? | Yop2D Guide
description: Make a character jump in Yop2D, without code: gravity, a solid floor, a jump button and the [[si_au_sol]] and [[impulsion]] nodes.
h1: How to make a character jump?
carte: Gravity, a solid floor and a jump button, with no jumping in mid-air.
etapes: Add a floor with {{lang:insp_cb_physique}}, left as {{lang:insp_btn_physique_statique}}.
blocs: For a character to jump, you need three things: it must **fall** (gravity), a **floor** to land on, and a **button** that pushes it upwards, only when it is standing on something.
a floor: a wide, flat {{lang:obj_prefix_carre}} named **floor**, at the bottom of the scene;
a button named **btnJump** (a {{lang:obj_prefix_bouton}} or a {{lang:obj_prefix_carre}}), at the bottom right of the screen.
Tap the **[[lang:insp_btn_physique_statique]]** button so that it becomes **[[lang:insp_btn_physique_dynamique]]**. « Dynamic » means the object falls.
The **[[lang:insp_label_gravite]]** setting changes how fast it falls: 0.5 to fall slowly, 2 to fall fast.
Tick **[[lang:insp_cb_physique]]** too, but **leave it as [[lang:insp_btn_physique_statique]]**: a static object does not move and stops objects that fall on it.
Put **player** a little above the floor.
You can make platforms the same way: static squares placed higher up.
Add the **[[NoeudEventClicObjet]]** event and choose **btnJump** as its target.
Add the **[[si_au_sol]]** node (category {{lang:cat_logique_conditions}}) and choose **player** as its target.
Link the output of [[NoeudEventClicObjet]] to the input of [[si_au_sol]], then the **{{lang:port_vrai}}** output of [[si_au_sol]] to the input of [[impulsion]].
Save, then start the game and tap the button.
**Why [[si_au_sol]]?** Without it, the player could jump again in mid-air and fly away by tapping the button several times.
**Negative = upwards.** In Yop2D, Y numbers grow towards the bottom of the screen. -15 makes a small jump, -20 a big one.
Add the left and right buttons from the guide [Move a character](guide:deplacer-personnage) (method 1). You can keep one finger on « right » and tap « jump » with another finger.
**The character doesn't fall:** check that it is set to [[lang:insp_btn_physique_dynamique]].
**It goes through the floor:** the floor must have [[lang:insp_cb_physique]] ticked, and stay static.
**Nothing happens when you tap:** check that the wires are linked, and that the output used is **{{lang:port_vrai}}**. Remember to save before starting the game.
**To compare**, open the **« Platform »** example game that comes with Yop2D: it uses exactly this setup.
